title: Reconciliation, evidence và repair queue
scope_items: Database Migration 00008: Added 3 PostgreSQL 17 tables (reconciliation_records, proof_bundles, reconciliation_matches) plus orders.matched_amount with full Row Level Security (ENABLE/FORCE RLS), tenant isolation policies, admin ops scope, strict foreign keys, and exact decimal types (NUMERIC(18,6)).

Protobuf Contracts & Multi-Target Generation: Defined 3 canonical services (ReconciliationService, EvidenceService, ProofService) with 13 RPCs. Compiled and verified cleanly across all 4 targets (Go, Connect-Go, TypeScript, Dart) with zero codegen drift.

Acceptance Target 1: Concurrent partial match cannot overallocate. AtomicMatch enforces settlement line remaining capacity and order capacity in both MemoryStore and PostgresStore (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE). Concurrently tested with 20 parallel threads under -race without data races or over-allocation.

Acceptance Target 2: Evidence modification denied. Content fields and deletion are strictly immutable (RULE-M19-005) via both PostgreSQL trigger protect_evidence_content() and Go store/service layers. SHA-512 content hashes are verified on submission.

Acceptance Target 3: Finance gaps do not leak to Viewer. Repair Queue / Data Gaps (ListPendingGaps), ReconciliationService.ListPending, Home Decision Engine (GetMobileHome), and metric drilldown (GetWhyThisNumber) strictly redact financial data, decision cards, and verified totals when queried by RoleViewer.
Proof Bundles: Claim assembly with verified supporting evidence and dynamic confidence band evaluation (high, medium, low).
Concurrency & Race Safety: All financial calculations and store operations pass -race test suite cleanly with zero data races.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestConcurrentPartialMatchCannotOverallocate and TestAsymmetricMatchCapacity pass with 100% clean race checks.
Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestEvidenceModificationDenied confirms content mutation and deletion are rejected with ErrEvidenceImmutable, and SHA-512 verification functions correctly.
Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestFinanceGapsDoNotLeakToViewer confirms Viewer cannot access finance gaps, verified revenue, or finance decision cards.
Proof Bundle Assembly Verified: TestProofBundleAssemblyAndConfidence confirms dynamic confidence band assignment and strict evidence ID verification.
Migration 00008 Verified: apps/api/internal/migrate/migrator_test.go verifies up/down transactional migration cleanly.
ConnectRPC Handlers Verified: ReconciliationServiceHandler, EvidenceServiceHandler, and ProofServiceHandler compile and bind cleanly with RBAC checks.
